title: Section-size bound for the affine etale generator
statement: For every scheme X in universe u and every U in the opposite of its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], the underlying type of the abelian section group G_X(U) of the concretely constructed sheaf [def-sc-etale-small-generator] is u-small.
